translations.answer: This post provides only simulation/real-time side-by-side video and approximately 10 mm obstacle clearance results, which can be used for demonstration but are insufficient for acceptance. At least, the model version, control frequency, contact/error pose estimation, repeat success rate, and failure samples should be recorded; these supplementary items are not included in the original post's solution.
translations.applicability: Applicable to finite acceptance for legged robots across Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, and real-time systems.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: Deploy Isaac Lab strategy on real robot and synchronize visual comparison in MuJoCo.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Compare simulation and real-time video side-by-side, but no error curves or state logs are provided.
translations.details.environments.0: Isaac Lab training; MuJoCo real-time display; four-legged real robot.
translations.details.limits.0: Not human-like; no success rate, dynamics parameters, control frequency, or cross-simulator error.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Video claims to clear approximately 10 mm step.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: How can we confirm that Isaac Lab training results remain effective in real robot after MuJoCo validation?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: Real robot obstacle clearance should be limited, and foot contact/pose errors should be recorded.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Original post does not report failures; only shows approximately 10 mm step as passed.
translations.media_summaries.0: Screenshot shows a side-by-side video of left simulation four-legged and right real-step scene; confirms comparison form, but no state curves, control parameters, or repeat count are visible.
translations.source.locator: Main text of the post and side-by-side video
translations.source.title: Four-Legged Case Study: Isaac Lab Training, MuJoCo Validation, and Sim2Real in Real Robot
translations.title: What Evidence is Sufficient to Demonstrate Sim2Real Success?
